reason: The cited evidence shows Sc-induced MgZn2 precipitates, grain refinement, and delayed phase transitions in Al2CoCrFeNi, but all data are for Al-containing HEAs, not the CoCrFeMnNi system proposed. The mechanism of grain boundary pinning inhibiting atomic rearrangements is inferred, not directly demonstrated.
premises: Sc addition to HEAs can form MgZn2-type intergranular precipitates
Precipitates pin grain boundaries and inhibit atomic rearrangements
This pinning delays high-temperature phase transitions
The effect is applicable to CoCrFeMnNi nanoalloys
